focus: Deep structural fix: eliminate duplicate config/session logic in app.py _handle_chat vs chat_stream

bugs.title: ~80 lines of duplicated config+session logic between _handle_chat and chat_stream/event_stream
bugs.description: Both _handle_chat (non-streaming) and chat_stream's event_stream (streaming) independently implement: ConfigStore DB loading, provider resolution, session creation, message loading, file parsing, message building. Any bug fix must be applied in both places - this is how the original ConfigStore NameError bug was missed in the streaming path.

bugs.title: Redundant local import of ConfigStore in save_config (line 865)
bugs.description: save_config uses 'from cscode.core.config import ConfigStore' locally. ConfigStore is already at module level. Minor style issue but same pattern that caused the original bug.
